finalCommanderRules.ruleset: Commander deck construction (Wizards Comprehensive Rules 903 / current Commander policy)

commanderChecks.name: Stella Lee, Wild Card
commanderChecks.reason: Legendary creature or card text explicitly allows it to be a commander.

rulesApplied: Exactly 100 cards including commander(s).
Normally one commander; two only when an applicable pairing mechanic permits them.
Partner variants are distinct: original Partner, Friends forever, Partner—Character select, Doctor’s companion, Choose a Background, and Partner with follow their own pairing conditions.

Commander eligibility includes legendary creatures, cards explicitly allowed to be commanders, and legendary Vehicles/Spacecraft with printed power and toughness; paired Backgrounds follow Choose a Background.
Every card must be legal in the Commander format.
Every card’s color identity must be a subset of the combined commander color identity; colorless cards are allowed.
Hybrid mana contributes all of its colors to color identity under the current rule.
Basic land types cannot introduce mana colors outside the commander color identity.
Except for basic lands and cards with their own copy-count exception, the deck is singleton by English card name.

rawRefinement.diversityGuidance: Default refinement explores the historical minimum candidate breadth, then continues only while each additional candidate produces a new blocked search state, with the existing six-candidate ceiling as a hard work bound. Explicit candidatePackagesPerRound remains an exact caller-controlled breadth for controlled benchmarks.
rawRefinement.winRouteGuidance: Route protection is derived from the existing V0.15 final full-table win-route portfolio. Verification unavailable is surfaced explicitly and never treated as evidence that the deck has no route.
rawRefinement.themeGuidance: User theme text is resolved once through the existing V0.15 controlled theme adapter. Mechanical/typal/card-type themes are audited on every candidate deck, compound themes additionally preserve every independently controlled component before aggregate density is considered, while physical printing-family themes are delegated to the exact printing policy. Raw user theme text is never appended to candidate Scryfall role searches.

commanderChecks.reason: Legendary creature or card text explicitly allows it to be a commander.

rulesApplied: Exactly 100 cards including commander(s).
Normally one commander; two only when an applicable pairing mechanic permits them.
Partner variants are distinct: original Partner, Friends forever, Partner—Character select, Doctor’s companion, Choose a Background, and Partner with follow their own pairing conditions.

Commander eligibility includes legendary creatures, cards explicitly allowed to be commanders, and legendary Vehicles/Spacecraft with printed power and toughness; paired Backgrounds follow Choose a Background.
Every card must be legal in the Commander format.
Every card’s color identity must be a subset of the combined commander color identity; colorless cards are allowed.
Hybrid mana contributes all of its colors to color identity under the current rule.
Basic land types cannot introduce mana colors outside the commander color identity.
Except for basic lands and cards with their own copy-count exception, the deck is singleton by English card name.

Aggregate theme density means a card matches at least one requested facet; individual facet achievement remains independent evidence and is not inferred from this aggregate gate. The finished main deck meets the minimum of 18 matching cards.

themeConstraint.explanation: The final deck independently satisfies the resolved V0.15 theme constraint. Generic utility cards remain allowed; only the required deck-level density or exact printing-family truth is hard-gated.

rawRefinement.explanation: Each round compared at least 3 and at most 6 materially different upgrade packages while new candidate search states were still being produced, using the same simulation seed, protecting the existing V0.15 verified primary/backup win-route pieces when verification was available, independently enforcing the resolved V0.15 theme at deck level when requested, then accepting the strongest package that stayed legal and passed printing, budget, regression, and minimum-improvement checks.

rulesApplied: Exactly 100 cards including commander(s).
Normally one commander; two only when an applicable pairing mechanic permits them.
Partner variants are distinct: original Partner, Friends forever, Partner—Character select, Doctor’s companion, Choose a Background, and Partner with follow their own pairing conditions.

Commander eligibility includes legendary creatures, cards explicitly allowed to be commanders, and legendary Vehicles/Spacecraft with printed power and toughness; paired Backgrounds follow Choose a Background.
Every card must be legal in the Commander format.
Every card’s color identity must be a subset of the combined commander color identity; colorless cards are allowed.
Hybrid mana contributes all of its colors to color identity under the current rule.
Basic land types cannot introduce mana colors outside the commander color identity.
Except for basic lands and cards with their own copy-count exception, the deck is singleton by English card name.

finalCommanderRules.ruleset: Commander deck construction (Wizards Comprehensive Rules 903 / current Commander policy)

commanderChecks.name: Lathril, Blade of the Elves
commanderChecks.reason: Legendary creature or card text explicitly allows it to be a commander.

rulesApplied: Exactly 100 cards including commander(s).
Normally one commander; two only when an applicable pairing mechanic permits them.
Partner variants are distinct: original Partner, Friends forever, Partner—Character select, Doctor’s companion, Choose a Background, and Partner with follow their own pairing conditions.

Commander eligibility includes legendary creatures, cards explicitly allowed to be commanders, and legendary Vehicles/Spacecraft with printed power and toughness; paired Backgrounds follow Choose a Background.
Every card must be legal in the Commander format.
Every card’s color identity must be a subset of the combined commander color identity; colorless cards are allowed.
Hybrid mana contributes all of its colors to color identity under the current rule.
Basic land types cannot introduce mana colors outside the commander color identity.
Except for basic lands and cards with their own copy-count exception, the deck is singleton by English card name.

rawRefinement.scoringGuidance: Competing packages are compared with the same per-round seed. The improvement score is still a within-deck heuristic, not a universal power score or measured multiplayer win rate.
rawRefinement.diversityGuidance: Default refinement explores the historical minimum candidate breadth, then continues only while each additional candidate produces a new blocked search state, with the existing six-candidate ceiling as a hard work bound. Explicit candidatePackagesPerRound remains an exact caller-controlled breadth for controlled benchmarks.
rawRefinement.winRouteGuidance: Route protection is derived from the existing V0.15 final full-table win-route portfolio. Verification unavailable is surfaced explicitly and never treated as evidence that the deck has no route.
rawRefinement.themeGuidance: User theme text is resolved once through the existing V0.15 controlled theme adapter. Mechanical/typal/card-type themes are audited on every candidate deck, compound themes additionally preserve every independently controlled component before aggregate density is considered, while physical printing-family themes are delegated to the exact printing policy. Raw user theme text is never appended to candidate Scryfall role searches.

finalCommanderRules.ruleset: Commander deck construction (Wizards Comprehensive Rules 903 / current Commander policy)

commanderChecks.name: Bello, Bard of the Brambles
commanderChecks.reason: Legendary creature or card text explicitly allows it to be a commander.

rulesApplied: Exactly 100 cards including commander(s).
Normally one commander; two only when an applicable pairing mechanic permits them.
Partner variants are distinct: original Partner, Friends forever, Partner—Character select, Doctor’s companion, Choose a Background, and Partner with follow their own pairing conditions.

Commander eligibility includes legendary creatures, cards explicitly allowed to be commanders, and legendary Vehicles/Spacecraft with printed power and toughness; paired Backgrounds follow Choose a Background.
Every card must be legal in the Commander format.
Every card’s color identity must be a subset of the combined commander color identity; colorless cards are allowed.
Hybrid mana contributes all of its colors to color identity under the current rule.
Basic land types cannot introduce mana colors outside the commander color identity.
Except for basic lands and cards with their own copy-count exception, the deck is singleton by English card name.

rawRefinement.scoringGuidance: Competing packages are compared with the same per-round seed. The improvement score is still a within-deck heuristic, not a universal power score or measured multiplayer win rate.
rawRefinement.diversityGuidance: Default refinement explores the historical minimum candidate breadth, then continues only while each additional candidate produces a new blocked search state, with the existing six-candidate ceiling as a hard work bound. rawRefinement.winRouteGuidance: Route protection is derived from the existing V0.15 final full-table win-route portfolio. Verification unavailable is surfaced explicitly and never treated as evidence that the deck has no route.
